newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar remains stuck in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar remains stuck in narrow range.

text.p: White sugar futures remained stuck in the narrow trading range set early in the day and the volume of trading interest remained low. Traders said there was no news or developments in physicals to encourage fresh trading interest and the New York market, too, failed to provide any meaningful lead.
At the close prices ranged from $070 to $0.10 a tonne up and turnover totalled 1,118 lots.
Paris white sugar was $0.90 up in the December position.
